name: Background downloads and uploads
plain: A system service finishes downloads and uploads for the app even after it is closed.
meaning: Lets apps move large files without staying alive. The transfer survives termination but not a force quit, and the system picks the timing.

android.note: Android 16 quota changes affect DownloadManager jobs

ios.persistence: nsurlsessiond continues after termination but not after force quit
ios.note: System schedules; discretionary transfers wait for Wi-Fi and power

limits.headline: Can finish downloads and uploads for the app even after you close it
limits.user_action: You tap Download or Upload, then leave the app
can: Continue large downloads and uploads while the app is closed
Wait for Wi-Fi or power for lower priority transfers on iPhone
Retry later if the network drops
Use Android DownloadManager with no extra permission
cannot: Run on a fixed schedule; the system picks the time, and optional transfers wait for Wi-Fi and power
Skip new Android 16 quotas on some download jobs
Transfer anything with no internet connection
limits.differs: iPhone's system schedules transfers and delays optional ones. Android 16 quotas affect some download jobs.

story.what_it_is: The phone finishes downloads and uploads for an app even after you leave it.

marketing.name: Background downloads
marketing.pitch: Apple lets a system service finish downloads and uploads for apps even when they are closed.

marketing.name: WorkManager
marketing.pitch: Android lets apps schedule reliable background work, such as uploads, that finish later.

story.for_you: You start a big download or upload and put the phone away. It finishes by itself and a notification tells you. If you force quit the app, it usually stops.
story.for_makers: Makers move large files without keeping the app awake, which saves battery. The system picks the best moment. The same tool could move data off your phone while the app is closed, so the system shows limits.

use_cases.example: A video app downloads a movie for a flight while your phone is in your bag.
A cloud photo app uploads your camera roll overnight.
A game downloads a big update in the background so it is ready when you open it.
A chat app uploads a long video message after you close the app.
A music app downloads new playlists on Wi-Fi at night.
A bad app sends your contacts to its server while it looks closed.

story.android_note: Android uses WorkManager and similar tools, with limits when the phone is in low power mode.
story.ios_note: iPhone's background session survives app termination but not a force quit.

history.change: DownloadManager covered by job quota changes
